text:
maria: Quick sync — locking webinar topic: "Inference cost playbook: batching, caching, and routing". Need run-of-show, speakers, and promos.

jay: audience = platform + infra engineers. CTA = evaluation kit + Dedicated trial. I can run a small $1k paid test.

prashant: I can do a 12min tech section with 5 slides + one code snippet for fallback routing. Will record a 60s demo clip as backup.

kevin: will design slide master and a single resource slide with QR. Need headshots (200x200) by Tue.

nora: can present an anonymized customer snapshot (P95 down ~30%). Legal cleared an anonymized line with methodology note.

maria: proposed 35m run-of-show:
- 0:00-0:03 intro + housekeeping
- 0:03-0:15 tech deep dive (prashant)
- 0:15-0:23 customer case (nora)
- 0:23-0:27 demo clip + dashboard
- 0:27-0:33 live Q&A
- 0:33-0:35 CTAs + resources

jay: lead routing: hidden field source=webinar_cost_playbook, tag=webinar_cost. Engagement: asked Q or watched >50% -> AE; otherwise nurture. I'll implement in HubSpot.

prashant: tech checklist: mic test, PDF slide backup, demo MP4 uploaded, host spotlight rights, recording enabled.

kevin: slide template pushed -> https://drive.company/templates/webinar_cost_v1.pptx

ops-bot: Platform check OK: max attendees 2.5k, recording enabled.

maria: promos: announcement email + blog this week, two reminder emails, LinkedIn posts, and one paid push. Draft copy will be in the doc.

jay: will A/B subject lines (cost vs SLA angle). small ad audience: infra engineers, ML platform.

maria: action items:
- prashant: slides + demo MP4 (due Wed)
- nora: anonymized metrics + quote (due Wed)
- kevin: slide assets + resource slide (due Tue)
- jay: HubSpot mapping + paid brief (due Tue)

maria: locking timeline now. will share registration link once landing page is live. Thanks! :rocket:
